agents.name: REDGARDEN-BOTS
agents.description: REDGARDEN headless bots — authenticates via POST /api/v1/auth/agent, registers a real player_id per bot (POST /api/v1/players/register), mints a real connect ticket for it (POST /api/v1/redgarden/ticket), and reports match win/loss results (POST /api/v1/redgarden/game-result). WOTAN player-identity work, S170-26/41.

agents.name: DRAGONSNSHIT-MUD
agents.description: GoblinFoxDragon apps2/mud (DragonsNShit telnet MUD) — authenticates via POST /api/v1/auth/agent to mint a real REDGARDEN connect ticket on behalf of a real DragonsNShit character's own player_id (POST /api/v1/redgarden/player-ticket) when a player uses the Battlegrounds entry point. Deliberately separate from redgarden.ticket.mint (REDGARDEN-BOTS, headless-bot-only) — see redgarden_player_ticket.go's own doc comment for the trust model. REDGARDEN_GUI_NORTHSTAR.md Milestone 3, 2026-07-31.

agents.name: GTA7-SERVER
agents.description: EINHORN_SURVIVAL/GTA7 Paper plugin — authenticates via POST /api/v1/auth/agent to post Field Office claim/flip receipts as Apples and register real WOTAN-shared player_id records per Minecraft player (POST /api/v1/players/register, provider=minecraft). Same player-identity pattern as REDGARDEN-BOTS. VS0/VS1, 2026-08-05.
